description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Move your character. Four ways to use it:

1. TO A PLACE YOU KNOW — pass to:"<place name>", a place you have found or a town. You can only travel to names you know: a place you have only HEARD of has no coordinates yet, so walk in the direction you were told until you arrive.

2. TRAVEL — pass x, y and z. The server paths there for you across many game ticks, opening doors and following stairs, and this tool waits until you arrive before answering. Use it for anything further than a couple of tiles. NEXT GOAL usually names the coordinates to use.

3. STEP — pass direction ("n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw") to take exactly one step. Use this only for fine positioning, such as stepping onto a corpse tile or backing into a corridor where fewer monsters reach you.

4. PUSH — pass push:{targetId, x, y} to shove a creature (or a pushable object) standing next to you onto a free tile next to it. Stand beside it first. The crypt asks you to push Corporal Ansel this way.

5. UNSTUCK — pass unstuck:true only when you are boxed in on all eight sides inside a temple or depot hall by players you cannot push. It puts you on a free tile of your home temple; at most once every ten minutes.

RETURNS: where you ended up, plus the fresh world view there.

COMMON FAILURES. "no_path" means the destination is walled off or too far — go in stages. A journey that CHANGES FLOOR is planned one leg at a time; when you stop on the right floor but the wrong tile, call again.

avoidCreatures.description: Refuse to path through tiles a monster stands on. Default true; set false when monsters are blocking the only corridor.

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

direction.description: Take a single step this way instead of travelling. A diagonal step takes twice as long as a straight one.

push.description: Push a creature or object next to you onto a free tile next to it.

targetId.description: Id of the creature or object to push, from golemreach_look.

x.description: Free tile x to push it onto. It must be next to the target.

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

stopDistance.description: Stop this many tiles short of the destination. Use 1 to stand next to something rather than on it. Default 0.

to.description: A place you know by name: a town, or a place you have found. Unknown names are refused.

unstuck.description: Boxed in on every side inside a protection zone? true asks the server to free you. Ignores everything else.

x.description: Destination x. Give x, y and z together to travel.

z.description: Destination floor. 0 is ground level, -1 is the first cellar. Defaults to your current floor.

name: golemreach_move
title: Walk somewhere
